# Drake Stapleton
> Freedom Fighter, AI Architect & Operator. A personal record of projects, research, and the life behind the work. Open to good conversation and research partnerships that advance what my generation can build with AI.

Drake Stapleton documents production orchestration, GPU systems, model training, community work, and Atlas.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.drakestapleton.com/): life and project record
- [Conversation](https://www.drakestapleton.com/interest): leave a note
- [Career path](https://www.drakestapleton.com/path): chemist to manufacturing engineer to AI Architect
- [Orchestration](https://www.drakestapleton.com/software): AI architecture practice and evidence
- [Audit](https://www.drakestapleton.com/evidence): source and evidence record
- [Atlas](https://www.drakestapleton.com/atlas): personal accountable AI research
- [AEGIS](https://www.drakestapleton.com/aegis): on-prem defensive Atlas extension and August 20 evaluation
- [Symphony](https://www.drakestapleton.com/symphony): multi-model orchestration process
